riskAssessment.reason: A missing or stale link between user instructions, plan rows, implementation paths, and acceptance evidence can incorrectly mark remediation complete and allow later release stages to proceed.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized the eight-stage sequence and required a full WI-01 through WI-20 bidirectional audit immediately after WI-10.

preReviewWarnings: Do not treat archived status, a broad scope glob, or prior full-acceptance wording as proof of exact instruction coverage.
A confirmed gap blocks audit closure and must be delivered through a separate corrective Work Item before this audit can finish.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The machine-readable audit contains exactly one row for each WI-01 through WI-20 and no duplicate, missing, or unknown WI identifier.

Every row binds the captured user instruction and authoritative plan section to exact archived Contract/Summary evidence, implementation paths or a specific no-change rationale, acceptance evidence, and verification commands/results.

Reverse coverage proves every claimed implementation path and acceptance artifact maps back to a WI instruction and plan locator; broad globs and completion labels cannot satisfy an exact named-path evidence rule.
The checker rejects missing evidence paths, invalid archive pairs/digests, empty evidence domains, duplicate ownership, unregistered no-change rationales, and a complete status with any open finding.

The human-readable audit is generated from or demonstrably aligned with the machine-readable facts and lists resolved, open, and corrective-required findings without capability or release overstatement.

Every confirmed omission is recorded with severity, exact evidence gap, release-blocking state, and corrective Work Item identity; the audit cannot archive until all such corrective Work Items are closed and the affected row is reverified.
The authoritative remediation plan and directive traceability manifest record the audit status, issue findings, and unchanged eight-stage order.

Focused red/green regressions, instruction traceability, full quality, documentation alignment, PR/Hosted checks, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, and main synchronization pass before the process-issues stage starts.
guidelines: Use archive manifests and index digests as evidence; never rewrite immutable archived Contract or Summary files.
Require exact file evidence or an explicit, evidence-backed no-change rationale for every user-named path.
Keep instruction-to-acceptance and acceptance-to-instruction coverage equally enforceable.
Separate audit findings from corrective implementation and from later process, Japanese, documentation-alignment, release, and cleanup stages.
Do not infer current capability, adopter readiness, or release readiness from historical completion wording.

intent.problem: The prior plan marked WI-01 through WI-20 complete in stages, but WI-10 proved that broad scope and archived completion wording can coexist with an omitted user-named file. Without a row-by-row bidirectional audit, other original instructions may also lack implementation or acceptance evidence while later release gates assume completion.
constraints: Audit all twenty Work Items; do not sample or stop at previously reported completion.
Preserve immutable archives and use exact paths, manifests, digests, and command evidence.
Do not implement confirmed omissions in this audit branch; create and close dedicated corrective Work Items first.
Do not advance to process issues, Japanese assessment, documentation alignment, release, or cleanup until this audit closes.
The user has already authorized continuous execution unless a genuine new human decision is required.
intent.rationale: A canonical twenty-row audit plus an executable fail-closed checker makes omissions visible in both directions and prevents a future Summary or plan label from substituting for exact instruction and acceptance evidence.

declaredIntent.summary: Audit every WI-01 through WI-20 instruction bidirectionally and block closure on any unmapped implementation or acceptance evidence.

rawUserRequest: After the deep performance Work Item and WI-10 close, audit every WI-01 through WI-20 using the instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance bidirectional mechanism. Do not rely on previous completion labels. If any omission is found, record it, complete a separate corrective Work Item through PR, merge, close, and branch cleanup, then re-audit before proceeding. Continue automatically unless a genuine human decision is required.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A WI is marked complete but one explicit user-named file has neither implementation evidence nor a specific no-change rationale.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The audit row and executable gate remain incomplete and release-blocking.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a mutation regression that removes a required named-path mapping from one audit row and assert the checker reports the exact WI and path.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An implementation or acceptance path appears in the audit but does not exist or is not bound by the cited archive manifest.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The checker rejects the stale or fabricated evidence reference.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add negative fixtures for missing paths, mismatched archive pair identity, and incorrect manifest digest references.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The forward mapping is present but an implementation or acceptance artifact cannot be traced back to one WI instruction and plan row.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Reverse coverage fails with the unowned evidence path.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a mutation regression with an orphan implementation and orphan acceptance path and require exact reverse-coverage errors.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: One or more audit findings remain open while the top-level audit status is complete.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The checker fails closed and identifies the open corrective-required finding.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a negative fixture that sets complete with an open finding and assert closure is rejected.
